best_idea: Keep one track group per game mood, pick a random alternative that is not the one just played, and let a one-shot cue hold the loop and resume it at the current mood.
decision_why: Take the mood-keyed groups, no-repeat pick and stinger hold-and-resume; the donor's stop fade never runs on a mood switch (defect, fixed in sketch) and a voice priority cap is added because the donor has none.
acceptance: A player who engages a creature hears the combat loop come in over 2 s while the peaceful loop goes out, and a second fight never restarts the loop track it just ended on (client director test: pickAlternative never returns the last index when two or more tracks exist; crossfadeGains sums to 1).
